messages:
ana: Quick sync — we need to lock scope & sequencing for the Q2 resource-fence launch. High level: product wants predictive caching + tenant burst lanes. Main cross-team risks: runtime batching semantics, infra capacity pinning, and security HSM gating. Can each team confirm a single owner + EOW acceptance criteria?

devon: @ana I can own eng-side sequencing. Need clarity on which APIs are hard SLOs vs best-effort so we can prioritize batching. Also: is there a hard deadline or flexible window?

sara: runtime note: batching semantics differ for cached vs uncached tokens — we have a prototype continuous-batching config but it regresses tail latency for 95th pct on short prompts. I can run a perf sweep this week if we freeze the request profile.

mike: infra: we can reserve GPU slots for the pilot but need commit on sustained qps. If product gives a target (tokens/sec per tenant) we can size a dedicated pool. Also flagging networking egress limits for the EU region.

jess: security: HSM/KMS approval for key material is the blocker. We need an approved ATO checklist item for customer-managed keys —without it we can't ship private deploy. I can run the compliance pre-check but need product's list of required protections.

ana: sorry meant @ana : can we standardize the acceptance criteria format? Proposal: one-liner owner, one-liner go/no-go, and one-line fallback for each dependency. Example: runtime -> owner: sara, go: 95th < 200ms on cached traces, fallback: degraded cache strategy + switch to smaller batch size.

devon: Agree on the format. For APIs: owner: devon, go: schema stable + contract tests green, fallback: route to generic generation model (higher cost).

sara: perf sweep plan: I'll run 3 configs: batch_size=[8,16,32], prefetch=true/false, kv_cache_prefetch=true. Will post results to the PR. Timeline: finish by Thu 16:00 UTC.

mike: infra sizing ask: product -> please confirm target sustained tokens/s and burst tokens/s per tenant. I'll create a capacity ticket: infra.atlassian.net/browse/INF-8721 with draft numbers.

jess: security timeline: need artifact request by Wed COB to hit audit window next week. If product misses Wed, HSM path slips 2 weeks.

ana: action items recap:
- ana (product): publish final tenant QPS + acceptance grid by Wed 12:00 UTC
- devon (eng): contract tests + route fallback plan by Fri EOD
- sara (runtime): perf sweep + PR with numbers by Thu 16:00 UTC
- mike (infra): capacity ticket + region constraints doc by Thu EOD
- jess (security): initial checklist + required artifacts list by Wed COB

ops-bot: Reminder: weekly release window is Fri 22:00-23:00 UTC. Any change requests after Thu 18:00 will be delayed to next window.

devon: I can commit to owning the sequencing plan; posting a lightweight Gantt in #product-roadmap by Thu AM. Will call out hard blockers.

ana: perfect — if teams hit their mini-deadlines we'll run a lightweight risk review Friday. If any team signals a miss earlier, flag in this thread and @channel. :thumbsup:
